movers.headline: completes a **Rs 2,100 crore QIP** at Rs 2,110 a share, the first leg of a **Rs 3,850 crore raise** whose Rs 1,750 crore promoter-warrant half is still subject to approvals

order_wins: **Marine Electricals (India)** — **orders aggregating Rs 398.81 crore** excluding taxes for power distribution systems, from Princeton Digital Group (India) Management over 18 months and Classic Electric over six to eight months _(~7.0% of mcap)_.

**Indo Tech Transformers** — a **Rs 55 crore Letter of Award from Waaree Renewable Technologies** for three 170/175 MVA and two 125 MVA power transformers, all five due between January and April 2027 _(~1.4% of mcap)_.
**Prime Cable Industries** — a **rate contract worth Rs 8,96,72,565.94** for LT cables from a joint venture of Tata Power and the Government of Odisha _(~2.4% of mcap)_.

**Prime Cable Industries** — a second order the same afternoon: a **Rs 8,48,42,000 purchase order** for LT cables from an undisclosed state distribution company, inclusive of GST, over four months _(~2.3% of mcap)_.

**Raaj Medisafe India** — a **Rs 17.02 crore letter of award from Madhya Pradesh Public Health Services Corporation** for 29,88,220 small baby diapers for state government hospitals, within 18 months and inclusive of GST _(~11.2% of mcap)_.

**HEC Infra Projects** — a **Rs 12.78 crore work order from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation** for laying, erecting, testing and commissioning 66 kV XLPE cable for the Rajkot zone, over 24 months _(~10.0% of mcap)_.
**Fascinate Textiles** — a confirmed **export order book of approximately Rs 12 crore** for execution over the four months from September to December 2026 _(~9.3% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**TechEra Engineering (India)** — a **Rs 5,00,66,400 purchase order** from an unnamed Indian public-sector aerospace and defence company for insourced structural assembly and supply of the HTT-40 front fuselage and coupling, over 24 months _(~1.8% of mcap)_.

**EMS Limited** — declares **Highest Bidder (H-1) status from NHAI** for user-fee collection at the Varshamedi plaza on NH-341 in Gujarat, an estimated Rs 28.39 crore over one year; the Letter of Award is still to come _(~1.4% of mcap)_.
**Sadhav Shipping** — a charter party agreement with **Lamprell Energy, UAE** for the vessel Adwita at **USD 7,900 a day** plus GST, for an initial 120 days extendable by a further 56.

**Transformers and Rectifiers (India)** — its revised press release names the end customer behind the Megha Engineering order published on 29 August: **generator transformers for NPCIL's Kaiga Units 5 & 6**, its first nuclear-sector order; no value is restated.

**AHAsolar Technologies** — a work order from **NLC India Renewables** to act as consultant for a 600 MW solar project with a 300 MW / 1,800 MWh storage system in Rajasthan, over 27 months; the order's own size is stated as confidential.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Piramal Finance** — completes a **Rs 2,100 crore QIP**, allotting 99,52,606 equity shares at Rs 2,110 to investors including ICICI Prudential, Nippon India, Kotak, BlackRock and Goldman Sachs Asset Management _(~4.1% of mcap)_.

**E2E Networks** — its board approves raising **up to Rs 1,500 crore** through a qualified institutions placement, rights issue, FPO or other mechanism, in equity shares or other eligible securities; no price or timetable is set _(~11.8% of mcap)_.

**Apollo Pipes** — a preferential issue of **31,00,000 fully convertible warrants at Rs 610**, aggregating **Rs 189.10 crore**, to eight non-promoters including AGDG Enterprises LLP and Sukumar Srinivas, convertible within 18 months and subject to shareholder approval.
**Kross** — approves issuing **15,00,000 equity shares of Rs 5 at Rs 212**, a premium of Rs 207 a share and about **Rs 31.80 crore** of fresh equity on our arithmetic _(~2.3% of mcap)_.
**AVP Infracon** — a **QIP of up to Rs 25 crore** in equity or equity-linked securities, in one or more tranches, subject to shareholder approval _(~17.4% of mcap)_.
**JMJ Fintech** — its board approves the **postponement and withdrawal of its proposed preferential issue** of equity shares, on review of the status of the transaction.
equity_allotments: **Neetu Yoshi** — a revised disclosure of its **27 August** board approval, filed at the exchange's request: **26,42,400 warrants at Rs 104**, convertible into equity shares of Rs 5, to promoters and non-promoters on a preferential basis.
**Orchasp** — approves converting a loan owed to a **promoter-group lender** into up to **1,50,00,000 equity shares of Rs 2 at Rs 4.74**, a premium of Rs 2.74: dues extinguished, not new cash.
**Trident Lifeline** — completes a **past warrant conversion** from the 9,94,200 fully convertible warrants issued at Rs 266 on a preferential basis in June 2025, not new capital.

**Z-Tech (India)** — receives NSE in-principle approval to list **1,07,000 equity shares of Rs 10** allotted on 13 August on conversion of preferential warrants: a past conversion completing, not new capital.
m_and_a: **Starlineps Enterprises** — completes the acquisition of 6,250 shares, **20% of Celloraa Energy, for Rs 40 crore**, making it an associate; a 50% subscription for Rs 160 crore was intimated on 29 June _(~11.1% of mcap)_.

**Muthoot Finance** — its board approves a **scheme of amalgamation of Muthoot Money**, a wholly owned subsidiary, into the company under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act; no swap ratio arises.

**Aar Shyam India Investment** — a **Detailed Public Statement for an open offer** for up to 58,43,327 shares, 26% of the emerging paid-up capital, by Radha Krishna Avudari, Sudha Rani Avudari and Nagabhyru Srikanth.

**IIRM Holdings India** — its wholly owned IIRM Global Shared Services allots it 29,98,385 shares at Rs 116, converting an **unsecured loan of Rs 34.78 crore** and extinguishing that much of the subsidiary's debt.

**Shanti Gold International** — approves buying 1,44,817 shares of **Lalithaa Jewellery Mart on the secondary market for Rs 3.88 crore**, at a weighted average Rs 265.76 including brokerage and taxes.
**Millworks Technologies** — takes **67% of Vidwan Aeronautics**, an aerospace engine-components maker, by converting a **Rs 2.75 crore** loan into 15,22,727 shares at Rs 18.05, with no cash outflow.

**Eco Recycling** — the ERI-Ecoreco partnership and the proposed **"ERI India"** venture with ERI of the United States are formally announced in Tokyo; no consideration, shareholding or timetable is stated.
**Park Medi World** — incorporates a wholly owned SPV, **Park Medicity Prayagraj**, subscribing Rs 0.15 crore for 100%, to build and run the 550-bed Prayagraj PPP hospital it won on 26 August.
capex_core: **Apollo Pipes** — its board approves an **investment plan of up to Rs 300 crore** to set up subsidiaries entering the tiles and ceramics business, including by acquiring operating manufacturers _(~10.8% of mcap)_.
**GHCL** — begins **commercial production of vacuum salt** at its Sutrapada soda-ash plant in Gujarat from 31 August, an annual capacity of 1.7 lakh tonnes that harnesses the plant's surplus energy.

**Active Clothing** — expands knitwear capacity, contracting **Ningbo Cixing of China for 106 computerised flat knitting machines** for its sweater division and simultaneously enlarging its circular-knits T-shirt division.
**Vraj Iron and Steel** — MoEF&CC transfers the **environmental clearance** for its proposed greenfield expansion at Chapka, Bastar, Chhattisgarh from Gopal Sponge & Power to the company.

**Ceigall India** — wholly owned Ceigall Green Energy MH2 commissions its **first 5 MW solar plant** at Ranjangaon Deshmukh, Maharashtra under MSKVY 2.0, ahead of schedule and so eligible for the incentive.

**Tata Power** — Tata Power Renewables commissions a **100 MW group-captive solar project** at Kayathar, Tamil Nadu, taking operational capacity past 7 GW and its utility portfolio to 12.3 GW; no value is stated.
business_updates: **Results season** — 6 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Zydus Lifesciences** — its **EVIDENCES-X Phase II(b) trial of Saroglitazar Mg in MASH** meets its primary endpoint, resolution of steatohepatitis with no worsening of fibrosis, at a treatment difference of 26.5% over 52 weeks.
**Cipla** — signs an **exclusive licensing agreement with SBP Group** for Rolditamig Deuderuxtecan (TQB2102), a HER2 bispecific antibody-drug conjugate; the covering letter states no consideration.

**Aurobindo Pharma** — step-down subsidiary Lannett launches the **generic of GSK's Advair Diskus** in 100/50 and 250/50 mcg strengths in the US, the first product from its inhalation pipeline to be commercialised there.
**Karur Vysya Bank** — opens **16 branches in a single day** across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka and Delhi NCR, taking its network to 919.
**Brandman Retail** — opens **ANTA's debut India store in Gurgaon** and doubles its India store target for the brand to 22, with 150 stores named as the longer-term ambition.
**Jindal Worldwide** — subsidiary **Jindal Mobilitric will expand to 100 showrooms by FY28**, the company says, extending its electric-vehicle retail footprint nationwide.
**C.E. Info Systems (MapmyIndia)** — partners with ClarityX to launch **Geo-FI**, a geo-intelligence stack that brings spatial data into BFSI lending decisions.
**Coforge** — unveils its **AI Adoption Fabric**, a framework it positions for outcome acceleration in enterprise AI programmes.
**Vintage Coffee and Beverages** — adds a **roast-and-ground coffee segment**, installing a roaster and targeting the United States and Europe as part of its premiumisation push.
distress_risk: **MT Educare** — files a Regulation 30 disclosure of **defaults on repayment of principal and interest** on term loans from banks and financial institutions.
**Race Eco Chain** — receives a **demand cum show-cause notice** dated 29 August from the Principal Commissioner of Central GST, Noida.
**Innovative Tyres & Tubes** — receives a **GST notice** from the office of the Commissioner, Vadodara, disclosed as an action initiated against the company.

**Flair Writing Industries** — discloses a **show-cause notice under Section 73 of the CGST Act** from the State Tax Officer, Valsad, continuing the GST scrutiny for FY 2022-23 it first intimated in February 2025.
other_notable: **Shiva Texyarn** — CARE **upgrades its long-term bank facilities to BBB+ (Stable)**, on a limit enhanced to Rs 98.08 crore from Rs 80.99 crore, with the short-term rating at A2.
**Life Insurance Corporation of India** — launches two products for sale from 7 September, **Bima Platinum**, a non-par savings plan, and **Jeevan Raksha**, a pure risk plan.
**Bondada Engineering** — files the annual secretarial compliance report required to **migrate its equity shares from the BSE SME board to the main board**.
**Meenakshi India** — its board approves a **sub-division of equity shares from a face value of Rs 10 to Rs 5**.

**Blue Cloud Softech Solutions** — a technology association with the Mahesh Babu Foundation launches **GMB Life**, a preventive-screening and wellness application running on the company's BluHealth platform.
